INSERT INTO warehouse_section_row_bins (workspace_id, warehouse_id, section_id, row_id,
             shelf_id, bin_code, bin_name)
         SELECT $1, $2, $3, r, s, c, n
         FROM unnest($4::uuid[], $5::uuid[], $6::text[], $7::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY
              AS t(r, s, c, n, i)
         ORDER BY i
